Author: Marcus T.
Review Text: The hygienist was gentle and thorough, and the front desk explained every charge before I paid. Overall, highly recommended.

Review Text: Invisalign consult was clear about cost and timeline. No pressure, which I appreciated.

Review Text: They squeezed me in for an emergency crown the same afternoon. Pain gone by dinner.

Review Text: Root canal with sedation and I remember none of it, in the best way.
